title: Add measured terminal-panel prewarm/idle policy
description: Add a measured terminal-panel prewarm/idle policy to reduce hidden startup cost. Problem: FN-004 found the hidden terminal panel can mount xterm and start a persistent ConPTY/shell session before user intent, improving first-open latency but increasing startup CPU, memory, and process/thread count. Target metric: reduce cold-start/idle memory while bounding first terminal open latency. Likely file scope: `src/components/TerminalPanelSurface.svelte`, `src-tauri/src/terminal_panel.rs`, `src-tauri/src/stack_popup/terminal.rs`, settings only if a user-facing toggle is chosen. Acceptance criteria: record current prewarm first-open latency and memory/process baseline; implement delayed/idle/on-first-open policy without breaking terminal session/tab/split semantics; terminal tests and manual PTY/xterm smoke pass; document before/after metrics and tradeoff.

steps.name: Capture Baseline Metrics and Existing Behavior
